title: BHF-COLLATE: UK Prospective, Multi-centre, Observational, Cardio-oncology Anthracycline Registry
official: BHF-COLLATE: UK Prospective, Multi-centre, Observational, Cardio-oncology Anthracycline Registry
summary: The study aims to collect information on how cancer treatment affects heart health. This will include collecting baseline medical information, storing blood samples, recording cancer treatment, and analysing heart scans across about 200 patients in several UK hospitals. We are aiming to: collect health information and store blood samples, alongside heart scans, to learn more about heart health after chemotherapy; improve understanding of why some patients develop heart problems, so that better tests, monitoring, and treatments can be developed in the future; build a UK-wide research group.
